data.one_liner: A strongly typed WordPress client for REST, GraphQL, and CRUD operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive, typed client library to interact with the WordPress REST API and WPGraphQL. Supports CRUD operations across 30+ endpoints, authentication methods, caching, pagination, and offline writes.
use_when: Building a Dart or Flutter application that communicates with a self-hosted or WordPress.com site
Needing typed models, queries, and mutations for WordPress REST or WPGraphQL APIs
avoid_when: Building apps that do not interact with WordPress or a CMS utilizing the WordPress API standard
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of WordPress REST endpoints, GraphQL, and custom post types
Built-in resilience features like caching, retries, and offline write queues
Cross-platform support including web, mobile, and desktop
weaknesses: Specific tightly-coupled ecosystem focused entirely on WordPress
data.setup_notes: Installs via pubspec.yaml with no complex native permissions or configuration required.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a generic, highly configurable HTTP client for custom API integrations rather than a dedicated WordPress wrapper.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic HTTP networking and want a lightweight alternative.
